title: GOOD: Sieve reject reason sanitized before SMTP response injection
description: smtp/session.rs filters the Sieve reject reason to printable ASCII + space only (c.is_ascii_graphic() || *c == ' ') and caps it at 200 characters before including it in the 550 response line. The comment explicitly names the threat: a malicious Sieve script containing embedded CRLF sequences could inject additional SMTP response lines. The is_ascii_graphic() call correctly excludes CR (0x0d) and LF (0x0a). This is a real SMTP response injection prevention, not a cosmetic filter. The 200-char cap prevents an arbitrarily long reject string from bloating the response.
